correctness.rationale: The exact minmod theorem is recovered from the cubic Hermite basis H=3t^2-2t^3, A=t(1-t)^2, B=t^2(t-1). For a single secant perturbation, minmod partial derivatives are 0 or 1; the central spatial derivative H’+pA’+qB’ is nonnegative for p,q in [0,1] because all four vertices are nonnegative, and has total integral 1. Each adjacent bump has variation 8/27, giving the global two-input upper bound 43/27 by integration and absolute summability. For every conservative affine-exact limiter a 1-to-(1-epsilon) central slope change forces both knot derivatives to decrease by at least epsilon and each neighbour bump to contribute at least 8epsilon/27, while the middle cell contributes at least epsilon; minmod attains equality. Independent exact rational bump and kernel checks corroborate. The classification does not extend to selectors exceeding the smaller secant, other grids or higher degrees.

Neither implies the universal 43/27 lower bound, attainment for minmod or its restricted minimax property. Indexing may miss an earlier equivalent theorem.
